description: 'Use when editing PictoLite French or English locale JSON, including control labels and metadata.'

# Internationalization Instructions

Read and apply [i18n](../../.agents/skills/i18n/SKILL.md) before changing locale messages.
It owns paired edits, namespaces, interpolation, reactive consumers and localized navigation.

Every locale-file change must have a matching change in the other locale in the same edit.
Keep key paths, nesting, value types and interpolation names aligned.
Use `snake_case` keys, French source copy and natural English equivalents.
Keep user-facing copy and accessible labels in the locale files, including preview controls.

Preserve valid JSON with two-space indentation, no comments and no trailing commas.
Inspect message syntax before adding literal `|` or `@` characters.
Keep translated content as text rather than introducing `v-html`.

Parse both files and compare affected keys and placeholders.
Fallback French output does not prove English completeness.
Use the skill's relevant compilation and locale-switch checks.
